name: Anatomy Ace
label: ANATOMY CHECK

deepdive.note: One Anatomy Deep Dive a day at 18:00 from Nov 7, 2026 (Yashas approved Nov 6). The 18:00 slot posts a quiz when no new deep dive is ready. Nov 10, 2026 (share plan, approved by Yashas): share-first videos go first (One Take, future parents, everyday warnings, then the most sendable of the rest); textbook processes (membrane transport, transcription, translation) last.

formats.note: Two of the five daily quizzes rotate through five short formats (Yashas, Nov 6, 2026): Which bone is missing?, Zoom out, Diagnose this, Myth or fact, Rank these. Each day takes the next two in the cycle; a format with nothing ready passes to the next, and with nothing ready at all the slot posts a quiz. Keep it until the Strategist has data on which formats win. Nov 9, 2026: a sixth format, "types" (Types of fracture: one femur broken 11 ways in a gray studio, anatomy/types.py), copied from a breakdown reel Yashas liked; with six formats each comes round every three days.

rotation_note: Nov 6, 2026: on Instagram, bone and muscle quizzes about famous, feel-it-yourself parts got 750-1,400 views at 1 day (10 of 15 since Nov 1); organ quizzes (heart, lungs, abdomen, eye, teeth) got 128-417 (0 of 6). So the two daily 3D quizzes use bone and muscle regions only. The organ banks stay for later (deep dives cover organs).
ramp_note: Only the 09:30 and 20:00 slots use quiz stock now (the others are deep dives and formats), so 14 unused questions (a week) is enough for all 5 slots.

notify.note: Add a trending sound from Instagram's Trending list. Keep the original audio (the voice) up and the song low, then post.
notify.why: Trending-sound test (Yashas, Nov 6, 2026): Ball Knowledge's hand-finished posts with a trending sound got about 1,000 Instagram views vs 155 for automatic ones (3 vs 10 posts). The 8 PM quiz's Instagram post goes out as Buffer 'Notify me'; TikTok and YouTube stay automatic.

first_comment.note: A 'Hint: ...' first comment under each Instagram post (hints.json, or a video's own "hint"). Off until Yashas approves: set "instagram" to true. Never on Notify-me posts. Each post is read back from Buffer and the run warns if Buffer dropped the comment.

hits_note: Hit check (anatomy/hits.py, daily after the tracker): an Instagram post 12-72 h old with 3x the median views (and 1,000+) or 3x the median shares per reach (and 2+ shares) of the last 30 Instagram posts of its own type makes its series hot for 5 days; a type with under 6 posts is compared with all Instagram posts at 2x. Deep dive series come from series.json. Hot series post first in their slots; hits.json keeps the record.
